name: campaign_volunteer

cost.note: No party budget spent; governed by per-round deployment capacity so donations stay preserved for Election Night.

tactical_role: Fast grassroots outreach unit (Kampanya Gönüllüsü). Excels at flanking unescorted Propagandists, capturing campaign activity share (15% election weight), and mobilizing undecided districts.
description: Low-footprint agile campaigner armed with flyers, megaphones, and street outreach energy. Strong in numbers against isolated Propagandists (+35% bonus damage vs unarmored outreach units), but quickly dispersed by armored Bodyguards (Koruma) or Security Squads.

name: propagandist

cost.note: No party budget spent; governed by per-round deployment capacity.

tactical_role: Ranged ideological influence specialist (Propagandacı). Projects persuasive media messaging across city districts, raises campaign persuasion modifiers, and pressures slow melee defenders when screened by Bodyguards.
description: High-impact rhetorical broadcaster who wears down opposing campaign morale from medium range and increases city voter receptivity during rallies. Fragile in close quarters; loses rapidly to swarming Campaign Volunteers (Kampanya Gönüllüsü) or infiltrating Saboteurs unless protected by Bodyguards.

name: bodyguard

cost.note: No party budget spent; governed by per-round deployment capacity.

tactical_role: Heavy close-quarters protector (Koruma). Shields friendly Propagandists and rally stages, intercepts Campaign Volunteers, and shuts down aggressive Saboteur infiltrators.
description: Armored political escort specialist with high health and melee deterrence. Hard-counters Campaign Volunteers (Kampanya Gönüllüsü) and deters physical Saboteur rushes, but slower movement speed makes Bodyguards vulnerable to kiting by Rally Convoys and ranged Propagandist crossfire.

name: security_squad

cost.note: Automatically assigned as a 5-person rally security unit to the active Speaker during rounds 1-6.

tactical_role: Five-person rally perimeter defense squad (Beş Kişilik Güvenlik Ekibi). Detects and captures a Saboteur who initiates physical brawl sabotage during a 60s rally.
description: Dedicated five-member rally security detail guarding the Speaker's stage. Cannot penalize verbal counter-speeches, but pursues and arrests physical Saboteurs (Sabotajcı). Capturing the Saboteur places them among 5 suspects for the Speaker's Revolver mechanic.

name: saboteur_agent

cost.note: Active role unit controlled by the non-speaking player during each opponent rally round (3 rounds per player).

tactical_role: Infiltrator specialist (Sabotajcı) entering the opponent's rally crowd. Chooses between penalty-free verbal counter-arguments evaluated by the LLM or high-risk physical brawls.
description: Stealth political disrupter embedded inside the rival rally audience. Verbal sabotage carries zero arrest penalty and contests LLM persuasion directly; physical sabotage deals severe damage to rally performance and donation yield, but risks arrest by the 5-person Security Squad and Revolver disqualification.

name: rally_convoy

cost.note: No party budget spent; limited to 2 mobile field convoys per round.

tactical_role: Mobile field campaign convoy (Miting Konvoyu / Mobil Saha Ekibi). Rapidly projects campaign visibility and presence across distant cities such as Dağşehir and Başkent.
description: High-mobility loudspeaker vehicle and mobile outreach team. Ideal for shifting campaign presence quickly between contested cities during the 30s preparation and real-time skirmishes, expanding fog-of-war scouting radius and outmaneuvering slow Bodyguard formations.
